about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

While Red was working on teleportation technology, there was a sudden explosion and he's thrown into a whole different world!

JOURNEY THROUGH BEAUTIFUL WORLDS!

Help Red explore different beautiful worlds as they try to find his way back home. Play through a gorgeous level of eye-catching and tranquil handmade art. Battle with different monsters, collect coins and gems, find the hidden runes, and unlock the exit portal to go back to your world! 

PLAY AS RED

Like a knight in shining armor, help Red fight with monsters and free the Protectors of the Forest. Collect and upgrade weapons, coins and gems, find your way to the exit portal to  back home.

HANDMADE ART

Enjoy beautiful hand-painted scenery as you progress through the game. With such lovely artwork, the game is fun to play, even with slow gameplay and minimal battle mechanics.

REVEAL THE HIDDEN CHESTS

Collect the magic runes from chests hidden around the level.

ACTIVATE THE PORTAL

Collect all the runes to unlock the portal and go back home!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mavericks 10.9 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2125 or AMD A8-6600K
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mavericks 10.9 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2550 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 7 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: The Adventures of Red is a simple platformer game with soft background music and fun gameplay, find his way through the Cursed Forest and back to his home.
